concerns.text: SC‑004 (data‑collection completeness measured against target N = 32 participants, requiring ≥ 28 valid completed sessions) is only addressed via synthetic‑session retention checks (Phase 7) and power‑analysis (Phase 4). The plan does not specify a concrete check that the real‑world study achieves the required ≥ 28 valid sessions out of 32 participants, nor does it enforce the target N = 32 recruitment criterion.
